ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Using the diagram, identify the organism that provides energy to the bluegill.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is a food chain flowchart titled “FERTILIZATION AND FOOD CHAIN”, containing multiple labeled organisms and arrows. In the lower-left position there is a small fish labeled “BLUEGILL”. Above it/on its left side there is a circle labeled “ZOOPLANKTON”; zooplankton are drawn inside the circle, and there is an arrow pointing from that area to the bluegill. Then reason: food chain arrows indicate the direction of energy transfer; the arrow points to BLUEGILL, indicating that the organism providing energy to the bluegill is the ZOOPLANKTON at the source of the arrow.
